name: Minutemailer
author: Minutemailer

sections.description:
Minutemailer for WordPress allows you to seamlessly integrate Minutemailer subscription forms into your WordPress website. This plugin provides a Gutenberg block that makes it easy to add beautiful, customizable subscription forms anywhere on your site.

Key Features:

  • Gutenberg Block Integration – Add subscription forms using the familiar block editor
  • Customizable Forms – Configure form fields, labels, button styles, and messaging
  • Optional Name Field – Choose whether to collect subscriber names in addition to email addresses
  • Success Messages – Customize confirmation messages after successful subscriptions
  • Minutemailer API Integration – Direct connection to your Minutemailer account and contact lists
  • Responsive Design – Forms look great on all devices
  • Easy Setup – Simple configuration with your Minutemailer API token

The plugin connects directly to the Minutemailer API to add new subscribers to your chosen contact lists, with automatic confirmation emails sent through Minutemailer.

Bug reports

Found a bug? Please report bugs in the Minutemailer for WordPress repository on GitHub

Source Code

You can find the unminified and source files at:
https://github.com/minutemailer/minutemailer-wp

External services

This plugin connects to the Minutemailer API in order to store your subscriptions as well as fetching your custom fields and contact lists.
You can read more about the API at https://www.minutemailer.com/developers/api .
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/minutemailer-wp directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to the ‘Minutemailer’ settings page in your WordPress admin menu
  4. Enter your Minutemailer API token (found in your Minutemailer account settings)
  5. Add the Minutemailer Subscription Form block to any page or post
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Minutemailer API token?

You can find or generate your API token in your Minutemailer account settings at https://app.minutemailer.com/u/settings/api

Can I customize the appearance of the subscription form?

Yes! The block includes options to customize the headline, description text, form labels, button styling, and success messages. You can also choose whether to show a name field and toggle between full-width and inline button styles.

Will subscribers automatically receive confirmation emails?

Yes, the plugin is configured to send confirmation emails through Minutemailer’s system when new subscribers are added.

What happens if my API token is invalid?

The plugin will display connection status information in the settings page, and subscription attempts will fail gracefully with appropriate error messages if the API token is invalid or missing.
